"clientScript": {
"css": "\na:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--147036ff-9b8a-4688-b8ff-4db51295fb84); outline-offset: 3px; }\n\n:scope::before { content: \"\"; position: absolute; inset: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--0c156811-e0a3-4cef-8a91-c22033b77970); pointer-events: none; }\n.mq-chip { background-color: var(--8e4fdec6-d4e9-4069-8a43-a0caf2a98c78); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--989b286a-2cd7-417d-acfc-96dfc6f29537) 14%, transparent), inset -1px -1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--3fb4df6c-ef8d-4113-a620-a8f96f1e2030) 80%, transparent); }\n.mq-chip:hover { background-color: var(--db57bb4f-0756-44ab-b6ce-9977adc4b7b3); }\n.mq-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); }\n.mq-chip[data-active=\"true\"] { background-color: var(--db57bb4f-0756-44ab-b6ce-9977adc4b7b3); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--989b286a-2cd7-417d-acfc-96dfc6f29537) 14%, transparent), inset -1px -1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--3fb4df6c-ef8d-4113-a620-a8f96f1e2030) 80%, transparent), 0 0 0 1px var(--a26a5991-5a44-439c-8a25-1356a27b9467); }\n.mq-chip:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--147036ff-9b8a-4688-b8ff-4db51295fb84); outline-offset: 2px; }\n@media (max-width: 576px) { :scope::before { inset: 10px; } }\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {\n  :scope[data-settled=\"true\"] .mq-chip { transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }\n}\n",
"js": "\nconst live = typeof window !== \"undefined\";\nconst chips = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll(\".mq-chip\"));\nconst inputs = chips.map((chip) => chip.querySelector(\"input\"));\nconst button = this.querySelector(\".mq-enquire-btn\");\nconst word = this.querySelector(\".mq-enquire-kind\");\nconst email = String((props && props.email) || \"studio@example.com\").trim();\nconst subject = String((props && props.subject) || \"Enquiry\").trim();\nconst phrases = chips.map((chip) => chip.getAttribute(\"data-value\") || \"\");\nif (!chips.length) return;\nlet current = Math.max(0, chips.findIndex((chip) => chip.getAttribute(\"data-active\") === \"true\"));\nconst paint = (index) => {\n  chips.forEach((chip, i) => chip.setAttribute(\"data-active\", i === index ? \"true\" : \"false\"));\n  const phrase = phrases[index] || \"\";\n  if (word) word.textContent = phrase;\n  if (button) button.setAttribute(\"href\", \"mailto:\" + email + \"?subject=\" + encodeURIComponent(subject + \": \" + phrase));\n};\npaint(current);\nif (!live) return;\nconst settle = () => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { this.dataset.settled = \"true\"; }));\nif (document.readyState === \"loading\") document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", settle, { once: true });\nelse settle();\n\nif (typeof this.mqEnquireCleanup === \"function\") this.mqEnquireCleanup();\nconst group = \"mq-kind-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);\ninputs.forEach((input, i) => {\n  if (!input) return;\n  input.name = group;\n  input.checked = i === current;\n});\nconst onChange = (event) => {\n  const index = inputs.indexOf(event.target);\n  if (index < 0) return;\n  current = index;\n  paint(current);\n};\nthis.addEventListener(\"change\", onChange);\nconst cleanup = () => {\n  document.removeEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", settle);\n  this.removeEventListener(\"change\", onChange);\n  this.mqEnquireCleanup = null;\n};\nthis.mqEnquireCleanup = cleanup;\nreturn cleanup;\n"
},
